title: Gamma Profiles of Waves Entering a Condensate
statement:
In the stochastic house-of-cards condensation model, suppose the mutant-fitness distribution satisfies $\mu(1-\varepsilon,1)=\varepsilon^\alpha\ell(\varepsilon)$, where $\alpha>0$ and $\ell$ is slowly varying at zero. If $\Xi_t$ is the empirical fitness distribution and $\gamma(\beta)$ is the condensate mass, is

$$\lim_{t\to\infty}\Xi_t\!\left(1-\frac{x}{t},1\right)=\frac{\gamma(\beta)}{\Gamma(\alpha)}\int_0^x e^{-y}y^{\alpha-1}\,dy$$?

## Literature review (checked 2026-08-21)

**Status:** open

**Assessment.** The gamma profile is proved for a simpler Kingman model, but the gamma-shape conjecture for the condensation wave in the reinforced branching model of the record remains unproved.

- [Dereich--Mailler--Morters, reinforced branching condensation](https://arxiv.org/abs/1601.08128)
